family.description: Members of this family may be involved in the activation of nickel-pincer cofactor-dependent enzymes. LarC from Lactobacillus plantarum is involved, together with LarB and LarE, in the synthesis of the enzyme-bound cofactor of lactate racemase (LarA). Larc C binds Ni2+, and functions in nickel delivery to pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide (P2TMN), to form the mature cofactor [[cite:PUB00085157],[cite:PUB00086644]].
family.name: Nickel insertion protein

record.description: Members of this family may be involved in the activation of nickel-pincer cofactor-dependent enzymes. LarC from Lactobacillus plantarum is involved, together with LarB and LarE, in the synthesis of the enzyme-bound cofactor of lactate racemase (LarA). Larc C binds Ni2+, and functions in nickel delivery to pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide (P2TMN), to form the mature cofactor [[cite:PUB00085157],[cite:PUB00086644]].

evidence.explanation: Methods and original Figures2/3/4/6 support scoped reaction-feature and reporter effects, not a fully observed atomic nickel-insertion pathway.

Full text, original Figures2/3/4 and TableS1 were inspected. Full-length structures supersede the older structural gap but do not directly observe nickel, natural-intermediate transfer or E104 chemistry.

discussions.notes: Inspect full2014/2016/2018 L. plantarum genetics, frameshift and engineered-fusion experiments,2024 analog chemistry,2025 expression studies and other mapped members. F9UST1 v2 is420aa with PF01969 4-406, distinct from LarC1 or LarC2 alone. No family-wide nickel occupancy, universal substrate specificity or native-cell mechanism is inferred. All earlier corpus follow-ups remain open.

evidence.explanation: Figure2B shows H72A above WT and no H70A; Figure3D shows small E243A/E300A/R323A changes despite full-activity prose. Figure4B and TableS1 disagree on shortened and flexible-linker sequences; TableS1 confirms LarE plus LarC plasmid content.
Methods specify MgCl2 while Results/Figure6 say Mn-CTP; Figure6 normalization and activity n1/error bars need clarification. No-added-nickel-growth protein was purified on nickel-affinity resin.
